subject: Reforecast: MAP & target close for NovaHealth
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@novahealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: MAP draft + next steps (NovaHealth)

Thanks again for your time today, Asha — really helpful call. Per our discussion, attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to capture milestones, owners, dependencies, and a target close so we can align expectations. Highlights: 

- Target close (initial): 2026-12-20 (tentative)
- Key milestones: Security review (NovaHealth SecOps), Procurement PO, SOW sign, Pilot kickoff
- Owners: NovaHealth SEC: Asha Patel; Procurement: Jordan Smith; Redwood: Marissa (AM) & Vivek (SE)
- Dependencies: SOC2 report upload, procurement window, sandbox access for pilot

Action items I left with:
1) Asha/Jordan to confirm procurement timeline and PO required approvals by 12/03
2) NovaHealth SecOps to confirm which artifacts needed for the security review (I can share our SOC2 + supporting docs)
3) Redwood to share updated MAP + SOW draft by EOD 12/03

Attached: NovaHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), SOW_draft_NovaHealth.docx

If the team prefers a shared Google Sheet for live edits, I can publish one — but thought the XLSX would be easiest for initial comments.

Thanks — talk soon.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@novahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Smith <j.smith@novahealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP draft + next steps (NovaHealth)

Marissa — thanks for the recap and MAP. Quick update from our side: procurement is slower than expected this quarter due to budgeting freezes across a couple of lines. Jordan and I discussed and we need to shift the target close out ~6 weeks to allow for the centralized PO queue and additional approvals (new target ~2027-01-31).

Also, our Security team asked for a short gap analysis before we move to an exec sign-off (they want to see where Redwood's SOC2 artifacts map to our checklist). I can get you the checklist and a SecOps contact (CC'd Jordan for procurement).

Can you do an updated MAP reflecting: new target close, move Pilot kickoff to after PO, and mark the SOC2/gap analysis as blocker? If so, we'll review and try to accelerate where possible.

— Asha

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@novahealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 11:23:00 -0800
Subject: Updated MAP (v2) + next steps — reforecasted close 2027-01-31

Asha — thanks for the heads up and context. Attached is NovaHealth_MAP_v2.xlsx with the changes you requested. Summary of updates: 

- New target close: 2027-01-31
- Pilot kickoff moved to "After PO issuance" (milestone moved to late Jan)
- Security gap analysis marked as a blocker for SOW execution; added SecOps artifact list column and deadline for NovaHealth to provide checklist (suggested 12/10)
- Procurement milestone updated with Jordan as owner and an internal Redwood task to support PO template if needed

I've also attached a lightly edited SOW (SOW_draft_NovaHealth.docx) that defers pilot dates until we have PO. Rafael — tagging you for visibility on any concessions we should consider in the SOW timeline. Neha — can you flag any contractual points that are impacted by the later start (we may need to shift payment schedule)?

Proposed short wins to keep momentum:
- Redwood to provide SOC2 + artifact mapping doc by 12/06
- Joint gap analysis session w/ NovaHealth SecOps: week of 12/13 (propose 12/14)
- Procurement check-in: Jordan to provide expected PO approval date by 12/10

Let me know if you'd prefer a brief call to walk through the updated MAP (15–20 min).

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: NovaHealth_MAP_v2.xlsx, SOW_draft_NovaHealth.docx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: notes on MAP v2 — security risk and pilot scope

Quick internal note after reviewing Asha's asks and the updated MAP v2: 

- Security gap analysis is expected; I'll prepare a short artifact mapping (SOC2 sections -> NovaHealth checklist) and a one-pager on how Redwood handles data retention and access. Target to share by EOD 12/06.
- Pilot scope: recommend we reduce pilot to a 2-week focused evaluation (1 model, 1 dataset) so it can be scheduled quickly once PO cleared. That will minimize effort on both sides and keep momentum.
- SOW: Rafael, we should add a clause that allows us to adjust pilot dates without penalty if procurement delays beyond 30 days from the original baseline.

I'm happy to present the artifact pack on the 12/14 joint session.

— Vivek

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@novahealth.com>, Jordan Smith <j.smith@novahealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Updated MAP (v2) + next steps — reforecasted close 2027-01-31

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turn. Asha/Jordan — just checking if 12/10 still works for the procurement update and if you can share the SecOps checklist by then. We will: 

- Share SOC2 + artifact mapping by 12/06 (Vivek)
- Publish MAP v2 as a Google Sheet for live edits (link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-NovaHealth_MAP_v2)
- Schedule a 30-min joint gap-analysis session for 12/14 @ 10:00am PT (will send invite once you confirm availability)

If anything changes on your side, we can re-adjust the MAP; this version is meant to capture the current commitments and the new target close of 2027-01-31.

Cheers — talk soon.

Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
